tracks.label: Instruments running on hardware
tracks.scope: Instruments that build and play on the reference RP2350 board (README, Status). Says nothing about how closely each matches the original; see each instrument's README.

tracks.label: Instruments in the release binaries
tracks.scope: Instruments built by CI and shipped as .uf2. RD, JV-880, D-50 and M1 need a local Roland or Korg ROM set that cannot be distributed and are built from source only; they will stay out.

tracks.label: Instruments covered by host tests
tracks.scope: Instruments with at least one suite in tools/host_tests/run_all.sh (engine, SysEx or front-panel render), run by CI on every pull request and push to main. Not a code-coverage figure.

tracks.label: PicoFaceOB: OB-Xf factory patches converted
tracks.scope: Patches of the OB-Xf factory bank converted by tools/ob_fxp_to_presets; the other 137 need two active LFOs, an off-centre master tune or a transpose outside the oscillator range (instruments/PicoFaceOB/README.md, Presets).
